method: Built-in image_gen, references are game screenshots and selected landscape illustration. Not a CLI/API workflow.
landscape: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: clean landscape key art for the actual indie game 风织雨 / Weaving Rain, 16:9, ideally 3840 x 2160 pixels. The two supplied images are STYLE AND SUBJECT REFERENCES from the current game, not images to paste or trace; the first shows its playable island, reservoir, farm, mountain and cloud, the second shows cloud layering. Create an original, thoughtfully composed editorial game illustration, not a screenshot or collage. Match the reference game's intentionally simple smooth vector-like surfaces and sparse flat colored layers, restrained shallow orthographic 3D depth. Teal turquoise ocean (#49a5ac), one irregular soft-green low island with a narrow warm cream sand rim and thin cyan shallow-water edge, one single rounded tapered green mountain, a small brown raised rectangular farm with a sparse orderly grid of 8-12 simple two-leaf sprouts, and a small circular cream stone reservoir filled with pale-blue water. These are the game's actual subjects: no buildings, people, animals, boats, trees, extra plants, ornate stones or terrain textures. A single smooth broad pearl-white cloud with 3-4 restrained grey-blue layered shapes underneath drifts just above the mountain toward the farm and pool, with fine straight light-cyan rain streaks visibly below its underside. Thin curved white wind strokes guide the eye from left toward the rain cloud. Keep clouds close to their real abstract smooth layered appearance: not photoreal, not elaborate fluffy sculpted puffs, not full volumetric cinematic lighting. Shade the green mountain with only two or three simple planes, use restrained soft contact shadows below the farm and pool; avoid dramatic reflections, noisy grass, painterly texture, bloom or excessive gradients. Composition: top-down oblique orthographic view, no horizon or sky. Island occupies middle-right and lower-middle; entire island, farm and reservoir clearly fit inside central 70% height and are not cropped; cloud rain and mountain clearly readable. Upper-left quarter is quiet open teal water for a separately laid out title. Sea remains calm and simple with a few long graceful white wind curves. Every pixel should feel like the actual small game elevated through composition, not promises of a different richer game. NO TEXT of any kind, NO lettering, NO logo, NO app icon, NO badges, NO UI, NO borders, NO watermarks.
portrait: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a 2:3 PORTRAIT cover illustration, ideally 1600x2400, for the game 风织雨 / Weaving Rain. Image 1 is the chosen original landscape key art to match EXACTLY in restrained visual language and palette; image 2 is the REAL game and limits the level of detail. Recompose this same island, single green mountain, brown 3x3 two-leaf crop bed, small circular cream-rimmed blue reservoir, abstract pearl-white rain cloud with nested grey-blue color shapes, fine vertical cyan rain and flowing white wind streaks into a coherent PORTRAIT illustration, not a screenshot or collage. Keep the whole irregular island inside the frame, filling the middle/lower 65%, diagonal elongated shape from upper right to lower left, cloud above the mountain in the upper-middle. Quiet teal water in top 23% for a separately placed title. Orthographic oblique view; no horizon, sky, people, buildings, trees, extra flowers or scenic inventions. Simple near-flat vector-like colors with very restrained 2-3 level shading and slight geometry thickness exactly as references. Cyan shallows and narrow cream shore. Cloud shape simple and smooth as in actual game, not fluffy billowing fantasy clouds. No noisy grass, painted texture, photoreal water, dramatic light, sparkles, ornaments, badges, UI or symbols. NO TEXT, NO TITLE, NO LOGO, NO app icon, NO watermark. This is a composed illustration of actual gameplay subjects, not a promise of richer graphics.
wallpaper: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an ultra-wide 3840x1240 (96:31 aspect ratio, approximately 3.1:1) TEXT-FREE PC game library background panorama for 风织雨 / Weaving Rain. Image 1 is the accepted original key art to match in restrained palette and shallow vector-like orthographic style; image 2 is the actual game and limits visual detail. Important deliberate composition: LEFT 40% is quiet low-detail teal ocean with at most two thin flowing wind lines, reserved for an application's overlay cards. All important subjects occupy RIGHT 55%, with a generous margin from every frame edge: a fully visible small soft-green irregular island, narrow cream shore and cyan shallow rim, one simple two-tone green tapered mountain, one small cream-rimmed blue circular reservoir, one small brown rectangular bed with a sparse 3x3 grid of simple two-leaf sprouts. A single flattened smooth pearl-white abstract cloud with nested grey-blue shading drifts above mountain/pool and rains fine short cyan vertical lines beneath it. Entire cloud and land silhouette fit within the ultra-wide frame without cropping. Sparse long white wind curves lead from left sea toward cloud. Gentle restrained shadow, little geometry depth, clean smooth edges and simple limited color layers, close to actual game's assets. No horizon, sky, mountains in distance, buildings, people, trees, animals, vehicles, island chains, vivid flowers, noisy textures, cinematic lighting, complex fluffy clouds, decorative fantasy details. NO TEXT OF ANY KIND, NO typography, NO logo, NO app icon, NO watermark, NO UI, NO framing. It should feel like a calm newly composed key-art panorama, not a stretched screenshot.
